Taxonomic classification of the most complete bins with GTDB-Tk. Commands for this step were run in `gtdbtk/`.
# Step 6: Perform taxonomic classification with gtdbtk

Change directory
```{bash}
cd ~/bbd-metagenome/gtdbtk
```

Copying results(topbins) into genome directory
```{bash}
while read bin;do echo $bin;done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt

while read bin;do echo "../metabat/bins_bbd/${bin}.fa";done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt

while read bin;do cp "../metabat/bins_bbd/${bin}.fa" genomes;done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt

ls genomes #check files in genomes 
```

Classification 
```{bash}
sbatch run_gtdbtk.sh #job 535
squeue #check position in cue
tail -f slurm-535.out #track jobs

#check status
sacct -j 535 --format=JobID,State,MaxRSS,Elapsed

```

```{bash}
#check output summary 
ls -l out/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv

#add summary to repo
cp out/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv .
# cp /pvol/data/mg/bbd/gtdbtk/out/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv .  #for premade results 
```
